title: Daemon streaming rollout must fix import blockers and cache control-plane reads
problem: High-frequency daemon rollouts can be blocked by unrelated syntax errors in modules imported through app.main, and per-tick control-plane reads make sub-second ticks impossible.
signals: factory_daemon starts but controller commands crash on import
daemon-status fails with SyntaxError from app.orchestrator or tool modules
tick logs show guard/recovery/tool-health dominating cycle time
fix: repair import-blocking syntax errors before assessing daemon runtime
cache guard, recovery, economics, autonomy and tool-health on most ticks
publish factory state and AI runtime on a cadence instead of every tick
run self_model asynchronously after the tick rather than inline
validation: daemon-status shows interval_seconds=1.0 and cycle advances
tick log shows cached=true on non-refresh cycles
